date_basis: BLS actual release calendars read through web tool, ET clock. No forecast/actual surprises in this file. FOMC decision dates exclude annual framework votes. BEA PCE dates will be parsed from original release embargo headers before any crypto-price requests.

hypotheses.primary: B2 price+flow recovery has positive cost-adjusted mean on 2025 evaluation and improves over B0/B1. All rules frozen before querying event price paths.
hypotheses.comparison: A first-rise pullback; B0 same risk filters without recovery; B1 adds stable low and breakout; B2 adds taker-buy recovery/selling exhaustion.
hypotheses.placebo: Same weekday and NY clock 7/14/21/28 days earlier, first nonoverlapping target-calendar window; not guaranteed news-free.
hypotheses.full_model: NOT_ESTIMABLE: historical consensus, PIT text judgment, and minute US2Y yields are unavailable. Never replace news direction with crypto response.
hypotheses.proxy_macro: Exploratory last available ~53 days NQ=F and ZT=F 5m closed-bar recovery only. Treasury futures price not a yield. Not equivalent to full model.
hypotheses.splits: 2024 development-reference(no fitting); 2025 fixed temporal evaluation; 2026 replication/exploratory, not untouched future OOS.
hypotheses.scope: Binance BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT SPOT. Standard fee input10bp each, base slip2bp each; same-fill extra0/2/5bp. No derivatives, funding, coupons or VIP.
hypotheses.clock_cutoffs: Morning releases no new trades in final10min before 10:00ET and flatten09:59 to avoid unmodeled10AM news. FOMC flatten14:29 before press conference, no new candidates from14:20. Same horizon convention for paired controls.
hypotheses.portfolio: 10000 USDT research ledger; risk0.2%, exposure20%, prior1m turnover0.1%; single position, BTC priority on exact tie, one attempt/event, daily-loss gate0.6%. No KRW monthly forecast.
hypotheses.no_tuning: No parameter search after outcomes; all alternative conditions reported including zero signals and unresolved paths.
